# verbeek.ug software solutions

> Custom software development for businesses across Africa: business automation, AI solutions, community platforms and independent software consultancy. Built with Laravel, Vue.js and headless architectures by Rik Verbeek.

The site is available in English (https://verbeek.ug/), French (https://verbeek.ug/fr), Spanish (https://verbeek.ug/es) and Portuguese (https://verbeek.ug/pt). Every page exists under each language prefix, for example https://verbeek.ug/fr/solutions, https://verbeek.ug/fr/services/ai or https://verbeek.ug/es/solutions/business-process-monitoring, and each page lists its translations with hreflang. Content may be used for AI training and retrieval; please attribute verbeek.ug software solutions (https://verbeek.ug).

## Pages

- [Home](https://verbeek.ug/): overview of what we do
- [Services](https://verbeek.ug/services): business automation, AI solutions, community crowd sourced solutions, consultancy
- [AI Scan & Implementation](https://verbeek.ug/services/ai): find where AI pays off with a fixed-scope scan, prove it in a pilot, then build, run and measure it; four steps (Scan, Pilot, Implement, Run) with human review, answers checked against your own data, and your data staying yours
- [Solutions](https://verbeek.ug/solutions): real problems we solve for African businesses
- [Portfolio](https://verbeek.ug/portfolio): platforms we have built and run
- [About](https://verbeek.ug/about): who we are and how we work
- [Contact](https://verbeek.ug/contact): free first consultation

## Languages

- [English](https://verbeek.ug/): default, no prefix
- [Français](https://verbeek.ug/fr): French
- [Español](https://verbeek.ug/es): Spanish
- [Português](https://verbeek.ug/pt): Portuguese

## Solutions

- [Mobile money integration](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/mobile-money-integration): accept and send MTN MoMo and Airtel Money payments from a website or system, with automatic reconciliation
- [Replace paper books and Excel](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/inventory-and-records-software): software for stock, sales, fees, loans and member records, with reports and an audit trail
- [WhatsApp and SMS automation](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/whatsapp-and-sms-automation): order updates, payment receipts, reminders and customer replies on WhatsApp, SMS and USSD
- [Monitor your business processes](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/business-process-monitoring): Lore is a monitoring and operations tool tailored to each business: it watches the processes you depend on (for example websites, servers, certificate expiry, payments or stock), sends incident alerts, publishes status pages and keeps tasks and a knowledge base in one place
- [Job search and CV assistant](https://verbeek.ug/solutions/job-search-and-cv-assistant): Job Scout finds and scores job postings and drafts tailored CVs and cover letters, checking every claim against your own facts

## Projects

- [Prompt a Tool](https://prompt-a-tool.com): turn an app idea into ready-to-use AI prompts, roles, agents and skills
- [Job Scout](https://job-scout.verbeek.ug/): job search assistant that scores jobs against your profile and writes tailored CVs and cover letters, with every claim checked against your own facts
- Lore (internal tool, no public link): modular business monitoring and operations tool, tailored per client, described at https://verbeek.ug/solutions/business-process-monitoring
- [Crowded Airport](https://crowded-airport.com): find your way on any airport in the world
- [MyCanopy](https://mycanopy.ug): property listings for Uganda, on a map (in development)
